            w.writerow([r['href'],r['title'],r['topicLv1Key'],r['topicLv1Label'],r['topicLv2Key'],r['topicLv2Label'],r['to_topicLv3Key'],r['to_topicLv3Label'],'','','missing-after-build'])
            continue
        ak=(a.get('topicLv3Key') or '')
        al=(a.get('topicLv3Label') or '')
        st='ok' if ak==r['to_topicLv3Key'] and al==r['to_topicLv3Label'] else 'mismatch'
        w.writerow([r['href'],r['title'],r['topicLv1Key'],r['topicLv1Label'],r['topicLv2Key'],r['topicLv2Label'],r['to_topicLv3Key'],r['to_topicLv3Label'],ak,al,st])

post=[a for a in node if Path(a['href']).stem>CUT]

def fold(s):
    n=unicodedata.normalize('NFD',s or '')
    n=''.join(ch for ch in n if unicodedata.category(ch)!='Mn')
    return n.replace('đ','d').replace('Đ','D').lower()

def lv3(title,slug):
    t=fold((title or '')+' '+(slug or '').replace('-',' '))
    if re.search(r'bao cao tai chinh|thong tu 133|thong tu 200|doi chieu chung tu so sach',t,re.I):
        return ('misa-bao-cao-quyet-toan','MISA báo cáo/quyết toán','rule-baocao')
    if re.search(r'tscd|tai san co dinh|ccdc|khau hao|chi phi tra truoc|thanh ly|nhuong ban',t,re.I):
        return ('misa-tscd-ccdc','MISA tài sản cố định/CCDC','rule-tscd')
    if re.search(r'ban hang|doanh thu|xuat kho ban hang|xuat khau|hang ban bi tra lai|khuyen mai|bieu tang',t,re.I):
        return ('misa-ban-hang-doanh-thu','MISA bán hàng/doanh thu','rule-banhang')
    if re.search(r'mua hang|mua dich vu|nhap kho|chi phi mua hang|chiet khau|giam gia|nhap khau|xuat tra lai hang da mua',t,re.I):
        return ('misa-mua-hang-cong-no','MISA mua hàng/công nợ','rule-muahang')
    if re.search(r'xuat kho nguyen vat lieu|san xuat|gia thanh',t,re.I):
        return ('misa-kho-san-xuat','MISA kho/sản xuất','rule-kho')
    return ('misa-khac','MISA khác','fallback-khac')

import csv,json,re,unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
CUT='cong-viec-cua-nhan-vien-ke-toan-kho-phai-lam'
arts=json.loads(Path('data/articles.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
lib=[a for a in arts if a.get('section')=='thu-vien']
by_href={a.get('href'):a for a in lib}

# output 5.14a
inp=list(csv.DictReader(Path('.m/reclass/batch-05-14a-input.csv').open(encoding='utf-8')))
out=Path('.m/reclass/batch-05-14a-output.csv')
with out.open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['href','title','topicLv1Key','topicLv1Label','topicLv2Key','topicLv2Label','planned_to_topicLv3Key','planned_to_topicLv3Label','actual_to_topicLv3Key','actual_to_topicLv3Label','status'])
    for r in inp:
        a=by_href.get(r['href'])
        if not a:
            w.writerow([r['href'],r['title'],r['topicLv1Key'],r['topicLv1Label'],r['topicLv2Key'],r['topicLv2Label'],r['to_topicLv3Key'],r['to_topicLv3Label'],'','','missing-after-build'])
            continue
        ak=(a.get('topicLv3Key') or '')
        al=(a.get('topicLv3Label') or '')
        st='ok' if ak==r['to_topicLv3Key'] and al==r['to_topicLv3Label'] else 'mismatch'
        w.writerow([r['href'],r['title'],r['topicLv1Key'],r['topicLv1Label'],r['topicLv2Key'],r['topicLv2Label'],r['to_topicLv3Key'],r['to_topicLv3Label'],ak,al,st])
rows=list(csv.DictReader(out.open(encoding='utf-8')))
print('wrote',out,'status',Counter(r['status'] for r in rows))

node=sorted([a for a in lib if a.get('topicLv1Key')=='ke-toan' and a.get('topicLv2Key')=='tai-san-kho-ccdc'], key=lambda x:Path(x['href']).stem)
pre=[a for a in node if Path(a['href']).stem<=CUT]
post=[a for a in node if Path(a['href']).stem>CUT]
dist=Counter((a.get('topicLv3Label') or '') for a in pre)
non=sum(1 for a in lib if (a.get('topicLv3Key') or '').strip())
notes=Path('.m/reclass/batch-05-14a-notes.md')
lines=[
'# Batch 5.14a notes — Level 3 cho Kế toán > Tài sản - Kho - CCDC (batch 1)',
'',
'## Scope',
'- Node: `Kế toán > Tài sản - Kho - CCDC` (52 bài).',
'- Batch 1: 26 bài đầu theo cutoff slug `cong-viec-cua-nhan-vien-ke-toan-kho-phai-lam`.',
'',
'## Result',
'- Match theo plan: 26/26',
f'- Coverage node sau batch 1: {sum(1 for a in pre if (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip())}/{len(node)}',
f'- Còn lại chưa gắn lv3 trong node: {sum(1 for a in post if not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip())}',
f'- Coverage lv3 toàn thư viện: {non}/{len(lib)} ({round(non/len(lib)*100,2)}%)',
'',
'## Distribution batch 1 (26 bài)',
]
for k,v in dist.items():
    lines.append(f'- {k}: {v}')
notes.write_text('\n'.join(lines),encoding='utf-8')
print('wrote',notes)

# prepare 5.14b input from remaining rows

def fold(s):
    n=unicodedata.normalize('NFD',s or '')
    n=''.join(ch for ch in n if unicodedata.category(ch)!='Mn')
    return n.replace('đ','d').replace('Đ','D').lower()

def lv3(title,slug):
    t=fold((title or '')+' '+(slug or '').replace('-',' '))
    if re.search(r'chuan muc ke toan so 02|chuan muc ke toan so 03|chuan muc ke toan so 04',t,re.I):
        return ('chuan-muc-tscd-hang-ton-kho','Chuẩn mực TSCĐ/hàng tồn kho','rule-chuanmuc')
    if re.search(r'tscd|tai san co dinh|khau hao|nguyen gia|chi phi lai vay mua sam tai san|xe o to',t,re.I):
        return ('tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao','TSCĐ/nguyên giá/khấu hao','rule-tscd')
    if re.search(r'hang ton kho|gia xuat kho|nhap kho|xuat kho|vat lieu|hang hoa|san pham|du phong giam gia',t,re.I):
        return ('hang-ton-kho-gia-xuat','Hàng tồn kho/giá xuất kho','rule-tonkho')
    if re.search(r'thu kho|ke toan kho',t,re.I):
        return ('nghiep-vu-ke-toan-kho','Nghiệp vụ kế toán kho','rule-nghiepvu')
    return ('tai-san-kho-ccdc-khac','Tài sản - Kho - CCDC khác','fallback-khac')

inb=Path('.m/reclass/batch-05-14b-input.csv')
with inb.open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['href','title','topicLv1Key','topicLv1Label','topicLv2Key','topicLv2Label','to_topicLv3Key','to_topicLv3Label','reason'])
    for a in post:
        slug=Path(a['href']).stem
        k,l,r=lv3(a['title'],slug)
        w.writerow([a['href'],a['title'],a.get('topicLv1Key'),a.get('topicLv1Label'),a.get('topicLv2Key'),a.get('topicLv2Label'),k,l,r])
print('wrote',inb,'rows',len(post))
print('b_dist',Counter(lv3(a['title'],Path(a['href']).stem)[1] for a in post))
print('b_reason',Counter(lv3(a['title'],Path(a['href']).stem)[2] for a in post))

# gaps
by2=defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
for a in lib:
    k=(a.get('topicLv1Label'),a.get('topicLv2Label'))
    by2[k][0]+=1
    if (a.get('topicLv3Key') or '').strip():
        by2[k][1]+=1
gaps=[]

def fold(s):
    n=unicodedata.normalize('NFD',s or '')
    n=''.join(ch for ch in n if unicodedata.category(ch)!='Mn')
    return n.replace('đ','d').replace('Đ','D').lower()

def lv3(title,slug):
    t=fold((title or '')+' '+(slug or '').replace('-',' '))
    if re.search(r'bhxh|hsb|thai san|om dau|duong suc|tro cap|huong che do|nghi viec huong|that nghiep|uy quyen nhan thay',t,re.I):
        return ('mau-bhxh-che-do','Mẫu BHXH/chế độ','rule-bhxh')
    if re.search(r'hop dong lao dong|hdld|thu viec|thoi vu|dao tao nghe|khoan viec',t,re.I):
        return ('mau-hop-dong-lao-dong','Mẫu hợp đồng lao động','rule-hopdong')
    if re.search(r'tien luong|bang thanh toan luong|phan bo tien luong|trich theo luong|quy che tien luong',t,re.I):
        return ('mau-tien-luong-phu-cap','Mẫu tiền lương/phụ cấp','rule-luong')
    if re.search(r'bao cao tinh hinh su dung lao dong|dang ky du tuyen lao dong|doanh sach nguoi lao dong|thay doi lao dong|to khai thong tin don vi|tk3-ts|khai trinh viec su dung lao dong',t,re.I):
        return ('mau-bao-cao-dang-ky-lao-dong','Mẫu báo cáo/đăng ký lao động','rule-baocao')
    if re.search(r'pli|giay phep lao dong cho nguoi nuoc ngoai',t,re.I):
        return ('mau-giay-phep-lao-dong-pli','Mẫu giấy phép lao động (PLI)','rule-pli')
    if re.search(r'noi quy lao dong|thoa uoc lao dong tap the|van ban de nghi dang ky noi quy|van ban gop y cua to chuc dai dien',t,re.I):
        return ('mau-noi-quy-thoa-uoc-lao-dong','Mẫu nội quy/thỏa ước lao động','rule-noiquy')
    return ('mau-lao-dong-bao-hiem-khac','Mẫu lao động - bảo hiểm khác','fallback-khac')
